spans.s:
पोषः [पृष्-घञ्]
1 Nourishing,
supporting, maintaining.
--2
Nourishment, growth, increase, advance.
--3
Prosperity, plenty, abundance.

पोषकः One who maintains or
nourishes, a supporter.

पोषितृ a. One who feeds, nourishes
&c. --m. A feeder.

पोषिन्, पोष्टृ a. [पुष्-णिनि तृच् च]
One who feeds, nourishes &c. --m.
A feeder, nourisher, protector.

पोषिन्, पोष्टृ a. [पुष्-णिनि तृच् च]
One who feeds, nourishes &c. --m.
A feeder, nourisher, protector.

पोष्य a. [पुष्-कर्मणि ण्यत्]
1 To be
fed, nourished or supported.
--2
Well-fed, thriving.
--3 Causing
prosperity.
--4 Abundant, copious.
--Comp.
--पुत्रः, --सुतः an adopted
son.
--वर्गः a class of relatives, who
must be nourished and protected.
